title: 5 Daily Habits for Better Health
description: Health/wellness video in square format for LinkedIn/Instagram grid. Uses Voicebox Kokoro TTS, bold captions, and moderate quality for faster rendering.
script:
Small daily habits create massive health transformations over time. [Visual: healthy lifestyle morning routine] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
Start your day with a glass of water before coffee. [Visual: glass of water morning sunlight] [Transition: slide] [Kinetic: on]
Walk for at least 30 minutes every day. [Visual: person walking park nature] [Transition: fade]
Eat more whole foods and less processed junk. [Visual: fresh vegetables fruits bowl] [Transition: slide] [Grade: vivid]
Prioritize seven to eight hours of quality sleep. [Visual: peaceful bedroom sleep] [Transition: fade]
Practice mindfulness or meditation for five minutes. [Visual: person meditating calm lake] [Transition: slide] [Grade: warm] [Kinetic: on]
Consistency beats intensity every single time. [Visual: fitness progress transformation] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
